title: iRacing BMW M2 Racing Oulton Park International Guide 1:50.0 BMW Racing G87 Oulton Park Track Guide

corners.braking: Brake to 45%, trail off, back on to 100% in fourth gear before apex.
corners.line: Wide exit without ending up in the grass.

corners.braking: Briefly brake to 45-50%, down to fourth gear.
corners.exit: Back on the gas to 100% before apex, exit wide.

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: Trail off to almost nothing, then increase to 100% on the gas.

corners.line: head slowly over to the right-hand side

corners.braking: braking as hard as I brake in the entire track guide
corners.line: head over to the left-hand side
trail it off, right hand tires just kissing that apex

corners.mistakes: never want to be braking harder than 60-65%

corners.line: Turn-in at gap between rumble strip and grassy hillock, apex at 100%

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: Brakes up to 45-50%, drop to 4th gear, up to 80-85% at exit

corners.label: T4
corners.braking: Instant lift to 4%, pick up gas at apex
Brake early to 55%, trail off to 3rd gear.
corners.line: Turn in early, apex next to tire barrier.
corners.exit: Get up to 100%, stay within track limits.

corners.label: T15
corners.braking: brake to 35-40%, trail off, pick up gas after first curbs
corners.line: turn in after left curbing, apex on second curbs
corners.exit: back to 100% by second curb, right tires over edge

corners.line: Right-hand tires over the edge of this rumble strip
corners.exit: Hold at around 70% until we unwind on exit

general_tips: If the car understeers, you are braking too hard.
Straighten the car out and use engine braking to slow down.
get right tires over edge of second curb
